content.short: Legato is a DeFi vault strategy protocol for liquid stakers on the Sui blockchain.
content.description: Sui staking APY has remained volatile, slipping from 4.5% in 2023 to about 3.5% by early 2024. Legato provides a way for liquid stakers to lock in APY at a fixed rate offered by a vault, guaranteeing staking rewards for a full year. The protocol is built specifically for liquid stakers, and it offers a range of vaults that are tailored to different needs, giving users options aligned with their time horizon and liquidity preferences.
